about.title: A scientific approach, ethical care and a trust-focused clinic.
about.description: Dr. Murat Irmak completed his medical education at Celal Bayar University Faculty of Medicine and went on to work in both public and private practice. He completed Ministry of Health approved training in traditional and complementary medicine, including mesotherapy, ozone, cupping and hirudotherapy, and continues his practice in Istanbul.

process.title: Four steps from appointment to follow-up

steps.title: Appointment
steps.description: A suitable time is arranged by phone, WhatsApp or the online form.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.description: Needs and expectations are discussed together during the physician consultation.

steps.title: Treatment

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.description: The process continues to be monitored with check-ups and aftercare advice.
